title: Petition of Hurley Associates, Inc. of Concord, Massachusetts requesting an extension of time to complete construction by one year from the date of issuance, August 1, 1989 in D.P.U. 89-36-I, or in the alternative, an exemption from the casing requirements of Rule IV of D.P.U. 12769 for a proposed crossing of the Tennessee Gas Pipeline a proposed roadway crossing at Forrest ridge in the Town of Concord, Massachusetts.
filings: ORDER ISSUED. Commissioners: Werlin, Tierney, Alexander (90-41-H).

Petition of Hurley Associates, Inc. of Concord, Massachusetts, requesting an extension of time to complete construction by one year from the date of issuance, August 1, 1989, in DPU 89-36-I or in the alternative, an exemption from the casing requirments of Rule IV of DPU 12769, for a proposed crossing of the Tennessee Gas Pipeline, at a proposed roadway crossing at Forest Ridge in the town of Concord, Massachusetts.
